notes.title: This is just the beginning!
notes.content:
Launch time is almost upon us and we're super excited for what we have to offer - now and in the future! There's so much more planned and it is going to be absolutely amazing. To get a sneak peek at what lies ahead and to get better acquainted with your fellow achievement buffs, we would like to invite you to the Discord server we have set up for you: https://discord.gg/njQk7C2

We hope to see you there and happy gaming!
